subject: READ statement
notes: kb/Work PB338 - LANDED 2026-09-06. cite.py --check 14.9.30.4 'Unless otherwise specified, at the completion of any unsuccessful execution of a READ statement, the content of the associated record area is undefined, the key of reference is undefined for indexed files, and the file position indicator is set to indicate that no valid record position has been established' -> OK 14.9.30.4 18); --check 12.4.5.9.4 'Any I-O statement that attempts to obtain a record lock that would exceed either limit is unsuccessful and receives an I-O status that indicates that condition' -> OK 12.4.5.9.4 7). RECORD-AREA LEG conforms (the emitters store the image only inside the success branch, so the area is UNCHANGED - a documented refinement of 'undefined'). KEY-OF-REFERENCE LEG conforms vacuously ('undefined' permits _refKey to survive). FPI LEG WAS THE DEFECT, on the record-lock-limit path only: a '53'/'54' denial is unsuccessful (12.4.5.9.4 GR7) and is NOT the record operation conflict condition - GR9 defines that as 'the record identified for access is locked by ANOTHER file connector', where these two are this connector's own lock COUNT - so GR10 a)'s 'otherwise specified' exemption does not reach it and GR18 applies in full. The denial used to be discovered AFTER the physical retrieval had succeeded and merely overwrote the status, leaving a successfully advanced position wearing a failure status. It is now a PRE-FLIGHT (FileRegistry.PreflightReadLock, the shape WRITE and REWRITE already used) and the denial calls FileConnector.ApplyUnsuccessfulReadPosition, which is GR18's invalidation. OBSERVED, conformance:cases/9.1.13.8-Record-operation-conflict-condition-with-unsuccessful/pb338_read_lock_limit_position - three legs (relative Format 1, indexed Format 1, relative Format 2; 12.4.5.9.3 SR2 bars the MULTIPLE phrase on a sequential-organization or sequential-access file, so the ceiling is unreachable there and no such leg is legal source). Each: the sixteenth lock request is '54', UNLOCK is '00', and the next sequential READ is '46' (9.1.13.7 item 6 b). Pre-fix every leg answered '00' on the record AFTER the one denied, silently skipping it. The ordinary unsuccessful paths were already right (at-end and '14' set LastReadUnsuccessful and clear _fpiValid; '51' is correctly exempted by GR10 a)).
